quarterly_data.quarter: ZTE investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: it offers full-stack solutions covering supernodes, a series of AI-computing servers, general-purpose servers, high-performance storage and AI all-in-one machines, from data center to edge. Its OEX supernode uses a multi-chip open collaborative architecture that supports flexible access and combination of heterogeneous CPU, GPU and DPU chips; a high-density design deploys up to 128 GPUs in a single cabinet; a zero-cable orthogonal interconnect architecture removes cabling fault points and signal attenuation; and it scales out smoothly to 1.6 ten-thousand (wan) cards for large-model training and mass inference.
quarterly_data.figure: Up to 128 GPUs per cabinet; scale-out to 1.6 ten-thousand cards
